name: CloudCLI
description: Web UI for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode CLIs: chat, file editor, terminal and git in the browser.

warmup: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild bcrypt better-sqlite3 esbuild node-pty sharp
test -x node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg || npm rebuild @vscode/ripgrep || { mkdir -p node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin && ln -sf "$(command -v rg)" node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg; }
install: test -d node_modules || { npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild bcrypt better-sqlite3 esbuild node-pty sharp; }
test -x node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg || npm rebuild @vscode/ripgrep || { mkdir -p node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin && ln -sf "$(command -v rg)" node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep/bin/rg; }

api.cmd: HOST=0.0.0.0 SERVER_PORT=3001 exec npm run server:dev
